description: This file configures testing for the extension messaging component in a Vitest environment, defining functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration for extension messaging tests.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env if no environment object is provided.

methods.name: export function createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig( createExtensionMessagingVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a scoped Vitest configuration object for extension messaging tests, using include patterns and specific setup options.
